label: Elementary intervals
subgoals: Collect and sort the distinct endpoints
Count the point leaves and the open gaps
Total them as 2m plus 1 elementary intervals

label: Canonical nodes
subgoals: Descend from the root comparing node ranges with the interval
Store the interval at nodes fully inside it
Count the canonical nodes, at most two per level

label: Storage and aggregates
subgoals: Decompose each interval into its canonical nodes
Add the node counts over all intervals
Maintain aggregates such as covered length at each node
